def transform(grid):
    # Find repeated nested motifs: the output encodes the pattern of color-3
    # accents in each of the two large patterned objects.
    # Object centers contain 6s; detect their overall 3-accent placement via
    # the bounded nonzero components and return a compact signature.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while st:
         y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
         for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
          if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx] and (yy,xx) not in seen:
           seen.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append(cells)
    # The repeated patterns are usually each independent component; read outer
    # shape's color-3 cells relative to its bounding box.
    large=[p for p in comps if len(p)>10]
    large.sort(key=lambda p:min(x for y,x in p))
    if len(large)<2: return [[0]]
    a,b=large[0],large[1]
    def accents(p):
      y0=min(y for y,x in p); y1=max(y for y,x in p); x0=min(x for y,x in p); x1=max(x for y,x in p)
      return {(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in p if grid[y][x]==3},(y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1)
    # Determine shape signature from color-3 border/edge placements.
    sa,da=accents(a); sb,db=accents(b)
    # demo pattern expected output is 3x7 representing two structures' top/bottom markers
    # Encode which edges have 3s in each object.
    out=[[0]*7 for _ in range(3)]
    for idx,(s,d) in enumerate(((sa,da),(sb,db))):
      width=d[1]; height=d[0]
      left=any(x==0 for y,x in s); right=any(x==width-1 for y,x in s)
      top=any(y==0 for y,x in s); bottom=any(y==height-1 for y,x in s)
      col=0 if idx==0 else 6
      for rr,flag in enumerate((top, (left and right), bottom)):
       if flag: out[rr][col]=8
      if idx==0 and left and right: out[1][1]=8
      if idx==1 and left and right: out[1][5]=8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Connected groups containing the distinctive central 6 pattern identify motifs.
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); p=[]
        while q:
         y,x=q.pop(); p.append((y,x))
         for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
          if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx] and (yy,xx) not in seen:
           seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        if any(grid[y][x]==6 for y,x in p): objs.append(p)
    # For each motif project its 3-marked contour into a 3x3 cell shape.
    objs.sort(key=lambda p:min(x for y,x in p))
    out=[[0]*7 for _ in range(3)]
    for k,p in enumerate(objs[:2]):
      y0=min(y for y,x in p); y1=max(y for y,x in p); x0=min(x for y,x in p); x1=max(x for y,x in p)
      for y,x in p:
       if grid[y][x]!=3: continue
       rr=min(2,(y-y0)*3//(y1-y0+1))
       cc=min(2,(x-x0)*3//(x1-x0+1))
       out[rr][(0 if k==0 else 4)+cc]=8
    return out
